What We Offer

Our Dental Services

From routine check‑ups to specialized surgery, our team is here to keep your smile healthy.

General & Preventive Care

  • Dental Check‑Up & Consultation

    Routine exams to catch problems early.

  • Scaling & Polishing

    Professional cleaning to remove plaque and stains.

  • Dental X‑Ray

    Accurate digital imaging for precise diagnosis.

  • Oral Hygiene Education

    Simple guidance for lasting dental health.

  • Children's Dental Care (Pedodontics)

    Gentle, friendly care for young smiles.

  • Dental Certificate for Medical Clearance

    Official dental exams and certificates.

Restorative & Surgical

  • Tooth Filling / Restoration

    Repair cavities and chipped teeth safely.

  • Root Canal Treatment (RCT)

    Pain‑relief treatment that saves the tooth.

  • Tooth Extraction (Simple & Surgical)

    Safe removal when a tooth can't be saved.

  • Wisdom Tooth Removal

    Expert care for impacted or painful wisdom teeth.

  • Dental Crown & Bridge

    Durable, natural‑looking tooth restoration.

  • Denture Services (Full/Partial)

    Comfortable, custom‑fit replacement teeth.

Cosmetic & Orthodontic

  • Teeth Whitening

    Brighten your smile, safely and gently.

  • Cosmetic Teeth Cleaning

    Deep polish for a fresher, brighter look.

  • Cosmetic Tooth Reshaping

    Subtle contouring for a more even smile.

  • Smile Makeover Consultation

    A personalized plan for your dream smile.

  • Midline Diastema Closing

    Closes gaps between front teeth.

  • Dental Braces

    Expert alignment for a confident smile.

  • Pre‑Braces Oral Care Consultation

    Getting your mouth brace‑ready.

Emergency & Additional Care

  • Toothache & Emergency Dental Care

    Fast relief when you need it most.

  • Pain Management

    Gentle, effective relief from dental pain.

  • Gum Disease Treatment

    Care for healthier, stronger gums.

  • Oral Ulcer Treatment

    Quick relief for mouth sores and ulcers.

  • Tooth Sensitivity Management

    Lasting relief from sharp tooth pain.

  • Post & Core Treatment

    Extra support for a tooth after root canal.

  • Dental Splinting for Loose Teeth

    Stabilizes loose teeth for lasting comfort.

Essential Tips for a Healthy Smile

Maintaining a healthy smile comes down to consistent daily habits — brushing twice a day, flossing, and cutting back on sugary snacks all make a real difference over time.

Benefits of Regular Dental Checkups

Routine checkups let us catch small issues — like early decay or gum irritation — before they turn into bigger, more costly problems. We recommend a visit every six months.
